page.overview:
Who is Ant Nostrum?

Ant Nostrum was approached by the Prisoner in Great Plaza in Arrakeen. She told them of the weapons she had on offer and situations in which their uses were ideal. She also explained that there were many pictured of Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV as both an icon and a metaphor, to symbolise that while he could not be in all places, all places were beneath his gaze. She responded to speculation that the photos contained hidden cameras by stating that the enemies of the Imperium were everywhere and only the Emperor and his Sardaukar stood in opposition. She opined that the Fremen dared to challenge the might of the Imperium and earned their fate, calling them "savage".
